rationale: Netherlands favored by ~80 Elo points and 2.8x squad market value, but arrive with severe squad disruption: Simons (ACL, best creator), Timber + De Vrij (two key CBs), and Verbruggen (GK, day-to-day hip) all missing or doubtful. Japan equally impacted: Mitoma (best winger, hamstring), Minamino (ACL), and captain Endo (foot, retired internationally) are all out. The prior encodes Japan's structural defensive excellence (def=0.3286) vs Netherlands' prolific attack (atk=3.0346) but relatively leaky defense (def=0.4501). Adjustments: NED attack -12% (Simons loss, Memphis off-form), NED defense +18% (triple CB/GK disruption); JAP attack -18% (Mitoma+Minamino absent, Japan's most impactful injury bloc), JAP defense +6% (Endo loss weakens press/screen but back-three is stable). Injury effects partially cancel. Market closing at ~+104 NED / ~47% implied win probability serves as the primary calibration anchor. Neutral venue at AT&T Stadium; no travel or rest advantage for either team.
